title: 第13章 富人高科技穷人搞变异第14章 给你机会你也不中用啊
slug: 我被系统坑成了造物主
content_zh:
正在众星捧月万众瞩目之际，广场前方突然凭空出现了几人，一看上空一名中年男子，两名年轻女子，一名老妪，两名年轻女子，一人蒙面，姜云天猜想应该就是青瑶长老，一个红光满面，笑颜如花那必然是被这些天一直滋润着的青鸳了，老妪面容苍老，应该是外门执法堂的长老，因为人的容颜一般会跟突破元婴期的时间早晚有关。
如果不是刻意变幻，本色出现，比较符合外门长老的身份，而试炼活动主要由执法堂操办，所以姜云天判断应是外门执法堂长老。
只见姜山郑重抬手，下方喧哗平息，姜山朗声道“我宣布，三年一度的宗门弟子试练开始。”
话声一落，下方山呼海啸般的掌声，姜山手中一挥，无数个玉符飞向在广场中弟子，准确对应到每个人，仙家手段非同一般，而看热闹的人身前则没有玉符。
让人啧啧称奇。
紧接着青瑶清冷的声音传出：“玉符中有本宗宗规，虽然大多数人已经很熟悉，但我们这次试炼，我再次强调，杀同门者杀无赦！
！”
青鸳手一挥，一艘飞舟出现，迎风而长，迅速变大，悬梯放下，姜云浩率先登船，紧接着结丹期、筑基期、练气期依次登船。
青儿和姜云天在自己的队伍中依次登船。
而姜山却是人影一闪，消失不见，做为一宗之长，要不是流程需要，他露个面都不想来，弟子试练，自有执法堂，太上长老负责，他才不想瞎瞎耽误功夫。
四个时辰后，到达一处山谷入口，一下飞舟，就闻到一股血腥气，不是人族的，是妖兽的血腥气，看来兽潮不仅仅波及到了谷外的人族，妖兽内部也在血腥自相残杀。
姜云天和青儿远远地交流了一个眼神，就独自向偏远的地方前行，试练有一个月时间，他要先熟悉血兽谷，了解自己的修为与能力，知己知彼，百战不殆。
血兽谷的妖谷非常嗜血，他们自相残杀，完全是以实力为尊的。
姜云天快速离开，等到周围没有人的时候，他开始运用五行遁，虽是小成，但在同级中已经处于遥遥领先。
持续沿着外围边界飞行了三个时辰，他估计，就是结丹期的修士，在没有身法技的情况下，普通飞行也至少要一天才能到达这里，他放下心，开始慢慢前行，他的记忆中有有试练的经历的，那时是姜云浩与他还有几位练气高阶的陪同，但他最后却落单，中了蛇毒。
现在他心里很清楚，姜云浩进来以后一定会找地方突破筑基，就是姜云浩身边的也是九重巅峰，他们最近一定是在功法和丹药方面堆的足足的，他现在不了解的情况下，是不可能随便行动的，所谓小心驶得万年船，他不可轻易冒险，一朝不慎，追悔莫及。
姜云天开始击杀妖兽，双头狼，三头犬，赤焰蛇，人面熊，这些变异的妖兽，嗜血凶残。
他也下手狠辣。
这让他想到蓝星，大美丽国，富人们用钱，用资源享受着美好的生活，而穷人却在拼命努力工作努力生存。
即使穷人们用自己的身体扛下了生活中的各种苦难，当灾难来临，他们却只能和自己周边的人竞争，甚至是拼命换取好一点的机会，或是为自己生命的延续拼了一次又一次的运气。

身体有了更强的抵抗力，因为病毒，有的人生出了抗体，这些穷人通过自己的不断变异而抵抗环境的对他们不停摧残，他们却只能靠自己的变异获得一线生机，而这些，会被大美丽国的富人们轻易用钱获取，大美丽的富人们花钱就可以得到穷人们梦想中的东西。
他们用钱获得高科技的生活，用钱获得更好的保障，用手中的资源和金钱，买到长寿的药物，甚至穷人的身体。
这和这个修仙世界很相像，人族和其他各族看似平等，虽然妖族有些人已经获得了和人族一样繁衍，修练的权利，但更多的是被人族圈养，在认为合适的时候，有人族的天骄们以杀血兽换取玉简上的一个个积分点，一条兽命就是一个数字点。
何其残酷！
姜云天想到这些，心中惨然，但他知道，他只有杀更多妖兽，才能获得更多的机会。
他站在这里，别无选择。
以身伺鹰的事，他不会干，放下屠刀，立成成佛，不可能，绝对不可能，成为妖兽的血食，想都不要想。
他有更多要走下去的理由，现在除了他自己，还有青儿、青鸳和即将降世的孩子。
前三天，他向中圈方向进发，所行之处，五行剑无坚不摧，对付炼气期的妖兽，如砍瓜切菜，轻松如意。
他对五行剑的使用也是随心所欲，好像五行剑隐隐和他有种联系，现在越来越强烈，非常有亲和力，像是那种血脉中的联系。
他是不太明白这是什么情况的，因为在他的认知里，圣品五行剑是他这个炼气期的修士无法催动的，但他却催动的很如意，他不解。
只能归咎于他母亲的强大了。
第三天，天快要黑了，姜去天来到了外围和中圈接壤的地方，看到前面有一棵大树，他用神念感知，然后并仔细地检查了周围，发现方圆十里之内没有一只妖兽，这让他很是惊讶，这棵大树有什么奇特的地方吗？他仔细地探查，有了新的发现，在大树旁边一个半人高的枯树桩下部，有一个树洞，树洞口有一个结界，可以阻挡外界进入，很显然树洞里不是人，但练气期的妖兽和筑基期的妖兽是没有神识的，不可能布出此阵，妖兽用阵盘，这种想法就更离奇了。
姜云天思考之际，远处天际，一团火光，带着强烈的闪光，照耀了天空，看方向，应该是血兽谷的核心区，是内区再往里的区域。
那感觉就像核爆，他马上想到，这是修士自爆，他估算了一下，他这里到核心区至少有四万里，这说明自爆的应该是化神期的修士。
content_en:
While the stars were holding the moon and everyone was paying attention, several people suddenly appeared out of thin air in front of the square. Looking at the sky above, there was a middle-aged man, two young women, an old woman, two young women, one of whom was masked. Jiang Yuntian guessed that it was Qingyao. The elder, with a rosy face and a smile like a flower, must be Qingyuan who has been nourished by these days. The old woman has an old face, and should be an elder of the outer law enforcement hall, because a person's appearance is generally related to the time when he breaks through the Nascent Soul stage.
If it was not a deliberate change and the true color appeared, it would be more in line with the identity of the outer sect elder. Since the trial activities are mainly organized by the Law Enforcement Hall, Jiang Yuntian judged that he should be the elder of the outer sect Law Enforcement Hall.
Jiang Shan solemnly raised his hand, and the noise below subsided. Jiang Shan said loudly, "I announce that the three-year sect disciple trial has begun."
As soon as he finished speaking, there was a tsunami of applause from below. With a wave of Jiang Shan's hand, countless jade talismans flew towards the disciples in the square, accurately corresponding to each person. The Immortal Family's method was extraordinary, but there were no jade talismans in front of the spectators.
It's amazing.
Then Qing Yao's cold voice came out: "There are sect rules in the jade talisman. Although most people are already familiar with it, in this trial of ours, I emphasize again that those who kill fellow sects will be killed without mercy!
! "
Qingyuan waved his hand, and a flying boat appeared. It grew long and fast in the wind. The hanging ladder was lowered. Jiang Yunhao was the first to board the boat, followed by the pill forming stage, foundation building stage, and qi training stage.
Qing'er and Jiang Yuntian boarded the ship one after another in their own team.
But Jiang Shan's figure flashed and disappeared. As the leader of a sect, he would not even show up if it was not required by the process. The disciples have their own law enforcement hall for trial, and the Supreme Elder is responsible. He does not want to waste his time.
Four hours later, they arrived at the entrance of a valley. As soon as they got off the boat, they smelled a smell of blood. It was not from the human race, but from the monster beasts. It seemed that the beast tide had not only affected the human race outside the valley, but the monster beasts were also killing each other in blood.
Jiang Yuntian and Qing'er exchanged glances from a distance, and then headed to a remote place alone. The trial would last for a month. He must first become familiar with the Blood Beast Valley, understand his own cultivation and abilities, know himself and the enemy, and be invincible in a hundred battles.
The demon valleys of the Blood Beast Valley are very bloodthirsty. They kill each other out of respect for their strength.
Jiang Yuntian left quickly, and when there was no one around, he began to use Five Elements Escape. Although he was only a small success, he was already far ahead of his peers.
He continued to fly along the outer boundary for three hours. He estimated that even a monk in the alchemy stage would need at least a day to reach here by ordinary flight without physical skills. He relaxed and began to move forward slowly. He had a trial experience in his memory. At that time, Jiang Yunhao was accompanied by several senior qi practitioners, but he ended up alone and was poisoned by snake venom.
Now he knows very well that after Jiang Yunhao comes in, he will definitely find a place to break through the foundation. Even the people around Jiang Yunhao are also at the ninth level. They must have accumulated enough skills and elixirs recently. He cannot act casually without understanding the current situation. As the so-called careful sailing leads to a thousand-year ship, he cannot take risks easily. If he is not careful, he will regret it.
Jiang Yuntian began to kill monsters, two-headed wolves, three-headed dogs, red flame snakes, and human-faced bears. These mutated monsters were bloodthirsty and cruel.
He was also ruthless.
This reminded him of Blue Star, a beautiful country where rich people use money and resources to enjoy a good life, while the poor are working hard to survive.
Even if the poor use their bodies to bear all kinds of hardships in life, when disaster strikes, they can only compete with those around them, or even fight desperately for better opportunities, or fight for luck again and again for the continuation of their lives.
The body has stronger resistance. Because of the virus, some people have developed antibodies. These poor people resist the environment through their own continuous mutations.They are constantly torturing them, but they can only rely on their own mutations to gain a glimmer of hope, and these will be easily obtained by the rich people in the beautiful country with money. The rich people in the beautiful country can get what the poor people dream of by spending money.
They use money to obtain a high-tech life, use money to obtain better security, and use the resources and money at hand to buy longevity medicines and even the bodies of poor people.
This is very similar to this world of cultivating immortals. The human race and other races seem to be equal. Although some people in the demon race have obtained the same rights to reproduce and practice as the human race, most of them are kept in captivity by the human race. When they think it is appropriate, the geniuses of the human race will kill the blood beasts in exchange for the points on the jade slip. A beast's life is a numerical point.
How cruel!
Jiang Yuntian felt miserable when he thought of this, but he knew that he could only get more opportunities by killing more monsters.
He stood here with no choice.
He wouldn't do anything like serving an eagle. Putting down the butcher's knife, becoming a Buddha. It was impossible, absolutely impossible. He couldn't even think about becoming the blood food of monsters.
He has more reasons to go on. Now besides himself, there are also Qing'er, Qingyuan and the child who is about to be born.
In the first three days, he marched towards the middle circle. Wherever he went, the Five Elements Sword was invincible. He could deal with the monsters in the Qi Refining Period as easily as chopping melons and vegetables.
He also uses the Five Elements Sword as he pleases. It seems that the Five Elements Sword has a vague connection with him, and now it is getting stronger and stronger. It is very affinity, like a blood connection.
He didn't quite understand what was going on, because in his understanding, the Holy Grade Five Elements Sword could not be activated by a monk in his Qi Refining Stage, but he was able to activate it satisfactorily, which puzzled him.
This can only be attributed to his mother's strength.
On the third day, it was getting dark. Jiang Qutian came to the border between the outer circle and the middle circle. He saw a big tree in front of him. He sensed it with his spiritual sense, and then carefully checked the surroundings and found that there was no monster within ten miles. This surprised him. Is there anything strange about this big tree? He carefully explored and made a new discovery. There was a tree hole at the bottom of a dead tree stump that was half a man tall next to the big tree. There was a barrier at the entrance of the tree hole, which could block the outside world from entering. It was obvious that there was no one in the tree hole. However, the monsters in the Qi training stage and the foundation building stage had no consciousness, so it was impossible to set up this formation. The idea of ​​a monster using a formation disk was even more bizarre.
While Jiang Yuntian was thinking, he saw a ball of fire in the distant sky, with a strong flash of light, illuminating the sky. Looking at the direction, it should be the core area of ​​the Blood Beast Valley, the area further into the inner area.
It felt like a nuclear explosion. He immediately thought that it was a monk who self-destructed. He estimated that it was at least 40,000 miles from his place to the core area, which meant that the self-destruction should be a monk in the transformation stage.
